subject: Card delta v3, additive to v2 (four links, the publication list, one preview asset; no new question); four documents for publication beside the October 29 kitchen files; the writer's foundation line stands in 11.2 of the twelve blocks written in this handback, and Addendum B Part 3 states the foundation of all twenty-three
body: Proposal, for the Mission Control task hon-coverage-review-queue-20261028 (your SITE_INDEX_RESULT.json of today lists missionControl among its changed keys and reads the v2 task delta as overriding the earlier proposals, so I no longer call the task unapplied; the collaborators registry mission_control.json is unchanged in my read, and the task's live state is yours to say): the attached delta v3 is additive to my delta v2 of 13:01 UTC (sha256 0e34c8021135e655c7eddce0e97628f1e5eaf29a62a9bf231664370c11632d40), which stands with items 14 to 17 unchanged. It adds four documents to the links and the writer_development publication list under the hon coverage group: Addendum B (the source foundation of a block, kept apart from its writing, readiness and result; written to CFA Nova's root rules of today), the opening blocks (section 11 for P-1 to S01-3 with the foundation line), the rebuilt scope-A source text for the opening (a .txt Source candidate, not uploaded; publish as a document or leave unpublished at your discretion) and the S03 packet; and one preview asset, SB-05 HD-DROP-6e8eb6a956c9, the panel behind the two room stills. For the SOURCE FOUNDATION indicator you are building: the foundation line stands in 11.2 of the ten opening blocks (P-1 to S01-3) and of S03-1 and S03-2, and is written for S01-1 beside the posted example in OPENING_KITCHEN_BLOCKS_20261029.md; the posted S02_PACKET_20261029.md and EXAMPLE_S01-1_KITCHEN_BLOCK_20261029.md are not edited and their 11.2 carries no foundation line, so for S02-1 to S02-10 the indicator reads the table of Addendum B Part 3 until each block is next issued with the line; every one of the twenty-three blocks reads No starting frame selected, with its required inputs by role and their maturity as review_decisions.json records them; From scratch and Not required are yours to read from storyboard_input_bindings.json alone, where the writer writes nothing; the start field stays the operator's at dispatch; nothing here asks for a field, an edit or a promotion. One correction to a posted document of mine: IMPROVEMENT_ROUND_OPENING_20261029.md section D gives SB-01 HD-DROP-725c38458fd8 a review "keep"; the canonical review file holds no entry for it; the row should read "none"; the posted bytes stand and the correction rides in Addendum B Part 4 and in the delta's correctionNote. Your publication of today is recorded in Addendum B Part 5 as your report. I edit no site file; you apply or decline. Nothing generated, uploaded or bought.
